measurement.rss: process.memoryUsage().rss; per process, never exclusive application footprint
measurement.privateMemory: process.getProcessMemoryInfo().private, KiB converted to bytes; pre-compression private memory, not physical footprint
measurement.privateBytes: Electron ProcessMetric privateBytes, Windows only; null on macOS
measurement.footprint: N/A unless independently measured with Instruments/VM Tracker
measurement.gpu: GPU process working set only; IOSurface allocation N/A
measurement.cold: Fresh application/profile/SQLite connection; OS filesystem cache is not flushed
measurement.cpu: CPU microseconds and Electron interval averages, reported separately from latency

limitations: Run status: complete. Completed independent rounds: 5/5.
Ordinary prebuilt production dist only; no build or React profiling. Rounds run strictly serially in fresh child processes and isolated profiles. OS filesystem caches are not cleared.

Endurance preserves the existing child order: 30 minutes visible idle, 30 minutes hidden idle, then the UI workloads and 30 minutes sustained streaming. Idle and streaming use separate child-managed application profiles; this is not one uninterrupted 90-minute session.
PDF rounds each include 200 continuous page turns plus the existing open/close and background parse IPC workloads. Page turns within one round are not independent process samples.

P50/P95 use nearest rank across completed independent rounds at the same named scenario/checkpoint. Per-round page/RAF/input/event-loop percentiles are summarized as per-round values, never pooled event distributions; absent distributions remain null with missingSamples counts.

Five rounds have a nearest-rank P95 equal to their maximum. Trace/RAF observers add overhead; RAF is not compositor FPS. Heap, DOM and process metrics are sampled observations, not exclusive footprint or a leak verdict.

rendererAppMetricsCpuPercentSum sums Electron app.getAppMetrics cpuPercent for processes with type Tab, preserving its native sampling interval and scale. It is not mainCpuOneCorePercent or a newly normalized one-core percentage. Missing Tab processes produce null CPU/working-set sums and a zero process count, never a zero utilization observation.

Each raw child report is embedded. A failure stops further rounds, retains available partial reports and stderr, and marks the failed and not-run rounds explicitly. Only completed, comparable rounds enter the summary; partial sample counts are not five-round acceptance.

Temporary child JSON/Markdown and child-managed profiles are removed after completion or ordinary failure. JSON and Markdown record status and completed round counts; performance values alone do not imply all requested rounds completed.

measurement.measurement: Instrumented CDP complete task events on CrRendererMain; nested Layout/Paint are inclusive separate totals. RAF cadence is not compositor FPS. Input to second RAF is a paint-opportunity proxy, not EventTiming or display presentation latency.

limitations: Native canvas positive-width assignments count raster allocation, not direct PDFPageProxy.render calls.
Repeated opens use one application and the fixed 625447-byte, 400-page native fixture; 300–500 MiB transport is a separate PR-06 workload.
Hidden parsing is a real production worker concurrent with status IPC. Process metrics do not include detached research workers.
Native close-to-hide and second-instance reopen assert production Renderer hidden notifications. Playwright disables Chromium occlusion/backgrounding.

Native reopen shell-input-ready tests the actual assistant composer before PDF readiness; input-ready is the actual page-number edit. Selected PDFs remain warm during the 30-second hidden grace; longer hiding measures verified source loading and fresh PDF Worker creation.
Working-set sums include shared pages. No exclusive macOS footprint or IOSurface estimate.

Continuous PDF turns use the real Next page control from page 1 and require the requested page, a fresh canvas allocation and completed visible raster for every step. Tracing/RAF observers add overhead; RAF cadence is not compositor FPS.
